entities.name: Query Nnr protein
observations: 518 aa soluble enzyme candidate with estimated molecular mass 55.46 kDa and pI 5.57.
Contains YjeF_N domain PF03853.22 at residues 28–196 and Carb_kinase domain PF01256.23 at residues 255–507.
Shares 35.7–38.5% identity over 96.3–99.0% of its length with reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr proteins.
Likely catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration, using potassium as a bound cofactor, based on conserved homolog evidence.

entities.name: B5YIM0
observations: Reviewed Thermodesulfovibrio yellowstonii Nnr homolog; 38.5% identity and 97.5% query coverage to the query.
Annotated with EC 5.1.99.6 NAD(P)HX epimerase and EC 4.2.1.136 ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activities.
Binds one potassium ion per subunit.
Participates in metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.

entities.name: NAD(P)H hydrate repair
observations: Repairs enzymatically or heat-generated NAD(P)HX, damaged hydrated forms of NADH or NADPH.
The Nnr reaction converts S-NAD(P)HX plus ADP to restored NAD(P)H, AMP, phosphate, and proton, while epimerizing R- and S-forms.
